text: The pipeline takes sparse input images of a face captured under varying lighting conditions.
A 3D morphable model is fitted to the input to establish a geometric proxy for lighting calibration.
From the proxy geometry, an estimated surface normal map is computed.
Semantic segmentation partitions facial regions, such as hairy areas versus bare skin, to apply tailored filtering.
Shadow processing explicitly identifies and handles shadowed regions across the illuminated images.
Using light calibration and photometric stereo optimization, the system reconstructs a refined geometric model with fine surface details.
A denoising stage refines the reconstructed surface into a smooth, high-fidelity 3D mesh.
At the same time, the diffuse albedo map of the subject is fully recovered.
